description: This file implements a dummy transport layer for the mcumgr SMP protocol used in unit testing. It handles serial communication, packet encoding/decoding, and simulates SMP message exchange for testing purposes.

methods.name: smp_dummy_clear_state
methods.description: Resets the internal state and buffers of the dummy SMP transport.

methods.name: smp_dummy_get_send_pos
methods.description: Returns the current position in the send buffer.

methods.name: smp_dummy_get_receive_pos
methods.description: Returns the current position in the receive buffer.

methods.name: smp_dummy_tx_pkt
methods.description: Transmits a packet over the dummy SMP transport.

methods.name: smp_dummy_enable
methods.description: Enables the dummy SMP transport to process data.

methods.name: smp_dummy_disable
methods.description: Disables the dummy SMP transport from processing data.

methods.name: smp_dummy_get_status
methods.description: Returns whether the dummy SMP transport is enabled.
